segments.sn51.23:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti, vīriyasamādhi … pe … cittasamādhi … pe … vīmaṃsāsamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti – ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro iddhipādā.
segments.sn51.23:1.8: Imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī”ti.

lines: Apica dve phalāni ādiṃ katvā heṭṭhā missakiddhipādā kathitā, sattasu phalesu pubbabhāgā.
835-842. “Dvinnaṃ phalānan”ti āgatasuttaṃ sandhāya “dve phalāni ādiṃ katvā”ti vuttaṃ.
